state.decision: The Test row of the Publish screen (row 11.153, Figma B6): the Publish checks are Style, Data, Assets and Scene, each OK or FIX, and Publish stays off while any says FIX. A fifth row, Test, would show what the engine's record check says (46 FIT, 2 NEED FIXING, each named). Is Test a blocker, how does it look before a check was made, and does Publish run the check?
state.facts: The record check is the engine's own measuring with the renderer's shaping (cmd_fit_report), one request, about a second; today the records are the graphic's one sample data record, later the rows of a CSV kept in the project. A result is FITS, OVERFLOWS n PX, EMPTY or MISSING path; an empty value is fine when the element has Hide when empty. The graphic may change after the check, which makes the report out of date. A graphic with no text bound to data has nothing to test. The engine may be unreachable. Publishing makes an immutable numbered package an operator cues live; it never puts anything on air by itself. Data bindings with no source already block Publish.
state.constraints: The Editor never says FITS for a record nothing measured; every state in words; a blocked Publish must say what to fix; the designer must not be stuck on a test they knowingly accept.

blocks.instructions: Does a Test row that says FIX block the Publish button?

criteria.A: No. Test is advisory: it shows FIX with the lines that need fixing, and Publish stays on. The other four rows still block.
criteria.B: Yes, like the other rows: any record that needs fixing keeps Publish off until fixed or Hide when empty or Auto-fit is set.
criteria.C: Yes, but the designer can tick 'Publish anyway' next to it.

unchecked.instructions: What does the Test row say before a check was made or when the report is out of date?

criteria.A: A neutral row 'NOT CHECKED' (or 'OUT OF DATE') with a Check records button; never OK, never blocking; the row is drawn only when a text is bound to data.
criteria.B: Publish runs the check itself the moment the panel opens and shows its result, with the row 'checking…' until it answers.
criteria.C: The row is drawn as OK until a check says otherwise.

when.instructions: When does the record check run for the Publish screen?

criteria.A: Only when the designer asks (Check records), on the row and on the Data screen; the one report is shared by both.
criteria.B: Automatically after every edit, in the background.
criteria.C: Automatically only at the moment Publish is pressed, refusing the publish if a record needs fixing.
